Describe the expected and actual behavior, version, OS, command or tool, and a minimal reproduction.

Include sanitized JSON and whether the result has `complete` or `coverage` fields. Missing assignments may be a known global-feed coverage limitation.

Use `mcp.example.com` in examples. Remove account identifiers, course content, cookies, tokens, credentials, internal addresses and personal file paths. Report vulnerabilities privately using SECURITY.md.
